# Top mutated genes, cohort-wide (PCGR VAF >= 5% applied to every mutation)

Adapted from the functional-category oncoplot script. The mutation-level
filtering is unchanged (nonsilent, PCGR tumor VAF >= 5%, same Match_key
logic), and the plotting function is reused as-is. The only thing that
changes is *which genes get plotted*: instead of curated pathway gene
lists restricted to an OncoKB set, genes are ranked cohort-wide by the
number of altered samples (patients) and the top 50 / top 100 are kept.

Cells, "% altered", Multi_Hit and "Mutations per sample" therefore agree
with `Full_MAF_nonsilent_VAFge5pct_gene_mutation_frequency_*.tsv`; this
is checked and saved.

```{r paths}
# ============================================================

# ============================================================

VAF_TAG <- paste0("VAFge", MIN_VAF_PERCENT, "pct")

allow_sample_gene_fallback <- TRUE

# PNG rendering can be slow for ComplexHeatmap.
SAVE_PNG <- TRUE
```

```{r colors}
# ============================================================
# Colors
# ============================================================

grade_cols <- c(
  "Grade I" = "#A6CEE3",
  "Grade II" = "#33A02C",
  "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
  "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD"
)

binary_receptor_cols <- c(
  "Negative" = "#1F78B4",
  "Positive" = "#E31A1C",
  "Unknown"  = "#BDBDBD"
)

base_mutation_colors <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation"       = "#1F77B4",
  "Nonsense_Mutation"       = "#D62728",
  "Frame_Shift_Del"         = "#9467BD",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins"         = "#8C564B",
  "In_Frame_Del"            = "#2CA02C",
  "In_Frame_Ins"            = "#17BECF",
  "Splice_Site"             = "#FF7F0E",
  "Splice_Region"           = "#FFBB78",   # counted as nonsilent (as in TopGenes)
  "Translation_Start_Site"  = "#E377C2",
  "Nonstop_Mutation"        = "#BCBD22",
  "Multi_Hit"               = "#000000"
)

get_mutation_colors <- function(types) {
  types <- unique(types)
  types <- types[!is.na(types) & types != ""]

  known <- intersect(types, names(base_mutation_colors))
  missing <- setdiff(types, names(base_mutation_colors))

  cols <- base_mutation_colors[known]

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    extra_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_cols) <- missing
    cols <- c(cols, extra_cols)
  }

  cols[types]
}
```

```{r helper_functions}
# ============================================================
# Helper functions (unchanged from the functional-category script)
# ============================================================

clean_key <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "nan", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
  toupper(x)
}

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  # Clinical file has TP03-117; MAF/PCGR may have TP03-117_T
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("-T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.T$", "", x)

  toupper(x)
}

natural_sample_order <- function(samples) {
  samples <- unique(as.character(samples))

  sample_clean <- sub("_T$", "", samples)
  tp_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^TP([0-9]+).*", "\\1", sample_clean)))
  tp_num[is.na(tp_num)] <- 9999L

  rest <- sub("^TP[0-9]+[-_]*", "", sample_clean)

  samples[order(tp_num, rest, samples)]
}

clean_hgv <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A", "nan", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
  x <- sub(".*:", "", x)
  toupper(x)
}

normalize_oncogenicity <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("[ -]+", "_", x)
  x <- toupper(x)

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[x == "ONCOGENIC"] <- "Oncogenic"
  out[x == "LIKELY_ONCOGENIC"] <- "Likely_Oncogenic"

  out
}

normalize_colname <- function(x) {
  toupper(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x))
}

find_col <- function(cols, candidates) {
  ncols <- normalize_colname(cols)
  ncand <- normalize_colname(candidates)

  hit <- match(ncand, ncols)
  hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)]

  if (length(hit) > 0) {
    return(cols[hit[1]])
  } else {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
}

get_col_or_na <- function(dt, candidates) {
  col <- find_col(colnames(dt), candidates)

  if (is.na(col)) {
    return(rep(NA_character_, nrow(dt)))
  } else {
    return(as.character(dt[[col]]))
  }
}

safe_file_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
  x
}

parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- NA_character_

  is_less_than <- grepl("^<", x)

  val <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x))
  )

  val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] <- val[is_less_than & !is.na(val)] / 2

  return(val)
}

clean_receptor_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))

  out[grepl("^Positive", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^Negative", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Negative"

  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"

  return(out)
}

clean_grade_status <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  out <- x
  out[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"

  return(out)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Variant-key helpers COPIED UNCHANGED from the TopGenes script.
# They must stay identical so Match_key agrees with the VAF audit table.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

vaf_clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("(_T|-T|\\.T)$", "", x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

vaf_clean_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

# Consistent genomic-allele key. MAF insertions with REF="-" use the left-flank
# coordinate, so the inserted sequence begins at Start_Position + 1.
edit_key <- function(chr, pos, ref, alt, maf_format = FALSE) {
  chr <- sub("^CHR", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(chr))))
  pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))
  ref <- toupper(trimws(as.character(ref)))
  alt <- toupper(trimws(as.character(alt)))

  if (anyNA(c(chr, pos, ref, alt)) ||
      !nzchar(chr) || pos < 1L ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", ref) ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (maf_format && ref == "-") {
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }

  if (ref == "-") ref <- ""
  if (alt == "-") alt <- ""

  # Remove identical suffixes.
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, nchar(ref), nchar(ref)) ==
           substr(alt, nchar(alt), nchar(alt))) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 1, nchar(ref) - 1L)
    alt <- substr(alt, 1, nchar(alt) - 1L)
  }

  # Remove identical prefixes and shift the position.
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, 1, 1) == substr(alt, 1, 1)) {
    ref <- substring(ref, 2)
    alt <- substring(alt, 2)
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }

  if (!nzchar(ref) && !nzchar(alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(
    chr,
    pos,
    ifelse(nzchar(ref), ref, "-"),
    ifelse(nzchar(alt), alt, "-"),
    sep = ":"
  )
}
```

```{r read_clinical}
# ============================================================
# Read clinical file (unchanged)
# ============================================================

cat("Reading clinical annotation file:\n", clinical_file, "\n\n")

clinical_dt <- fread(
  clinical_file,
  sep = ",",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "N/A")
)

clinical_dt[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Sample)]

clinical_dt[, tumor_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(`tumor_cellularity (%)`)]

clinical_dt[, pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct := parse_percent_value(
  `pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)`
)]

clinical_dt[, TILs_pct := parse_percent_value(`TILs (%)`)]

clinical_dt[, Grade_clean := clean_grade_status(`Grade/Differentiation-Desc`)]

clinical_dt[, HER2_status := clean_receptor_status(`BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc`)]

clinical_dt[, ER_status := clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #1 (ER)`)]

clinical_dt[, PR_status := clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #2 (PR)`)]

clinical_plot_dt <- unique(
  clinical_dt[
    ,
    .(
      Sample_key,
      tumor_cellularity_pct,
      pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
      TILs_pct,
      Grade_clean,
      HER2_status,
      ER_status,
      PR_status
    )
  ],
  by = "Sample_key"
)

cat("Clinical samples:", nrow(clinical_plot_dt), "\n\n")
```

```{r read_maf_and_rank_genes}
# ============================================================
# Read the MAF and keep only nonsilent mutations with
# PCGR tumor VAF >= 5%, exactly as in the TopGenes frequency table
# ============================================================

cat("Reading combined MAF:\n", combined_maf_file, "\n\n")

# fread (not read.maf) so Splice_Region rows are kept, as in TopGenes.
maf_full <- fread(
  combined_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")
)

required_maf_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Variant_Classification",
  "Chromosome", "Start_Position", "Reference_Allele", "Tumor_Seq_Allele2"
)
missing_required <- setdiff(required_maf_cols, colnames(maf_full))
if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required MAF columns: ", paste(missing_required, collapse = ", "))
}

# Cohort (denominator for "% altered") = every tumor in the MAF, TP order.
all_samples <- natural_sample_order(unique(as.character(maf_full$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)))
cat("Cohort samples:", length(all_samples), "\n")

# Step 1: rebuild the TopGenes sample|gene|variant key for every MAF row.
maf_full[, Variant_key := mapply(
  edit_key,
  Chromosome, Start_Position, Reference_Allele, Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
  MoreArgs = list(maf_format = TRUE),
  USE.NAMES = FALSE
)]
maf_full[, Match_key := paste(
  vaf_clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
  vaf_clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol),
  Variant_key,
  sep = "|"
)]

# Step 2: attach PCGR VAF from the TopGenes audit (one value per key).
vaf_audit <- fread(vaf_audit_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)
if (!all(c("Match_key", "VAF_TUMOR_fraction") %in% colnames(vaf_audit))) {
  stop("VAF audit file must contain Match_key and VAF_TUMOR_fraction columns.")
}
vaf_by_key <- unique(
  vaf_audit[, .(Match_key,
                VAF_TUMOR_fraction = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(VAF_TUMOR_fraction)))],
  by = "Match_key"
)
maf_full <- merge(maf_full, vaf_by_key, by = "Match_key", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)

# Step 3: same retention rule as TopGenes.
maf_full[, Is_nonsilent := Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes]
maf_full[, VAF_status := fifelse(
  is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction), "excluded_missing_VAF",
  fifelse(VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= MIN_VAF, "retained_VAF_ge_cutoff", "excluded_VAF_lt_cutoff")
)]

maf_dt <- maf_full[
  Is_nonsilent == TRUE &
    !is.na(vaf_clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol)) &
    VAF_status == "retained_VAF_ge_cutoff"
]
maf_dt[, Variant_Classification := as.character(Variant_Classification)]
maf_dt[, VAF_percent := round(100 * VAF_TUMOR_fraction, 2)]

# What the filter removed (nonsilent rows only).
vaf_filter_summary <- maf_full[Is_nonsilent == TRUE, .N, by = VAF_status][order(VAF_status)]
cat("\nNonsilent MAF rows by VAF status:\n")
print(vaf_filter_summary)
fwrite(vaf_filter_summary,
       file.path(table_dir, paste0("MAF_nonsilent_rows_by_VAF_status_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

cat("\nMutations retained for plotting (nonsilent, ", VAF_LABEL, "): ", nrow(maf_dt), "\n\n", sep = "")

maf_dt[, maf_row_id := .I]
maf_dt[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
maf_dt[, Gene_key := clean_key(Hugo_Symbol)]

# ============================================================
# Rank every gene cohort-wide by number of altered samples,
# then take the top N gene sets (replaces the functional-category /
# OncoKB-restriction step from the pathway-based script).
# ============================================================

gene_summary <- maf_dt[
  ,
  .(
    n_altered_samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    n_variant_rows = .N
  ),
  by = .(Gene_key, Hugo_Symbol)
]

setorder(gene_summary, -n_altered_samples, -n_variant_rows, Hugo_Symbol)
gene_summary[, Rank := .I]

fwrite(
  gene_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, paste0("cohort_gene_ranking_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = ""
)

top_gene_sets <- setNames(
  lapply(TOP_N_VALUES, function(n) head(gene_summary$Hugo_Symbol, n)),
  paste0("Top", TOP_N_VALUES, "_Genes_Cohort")
)

cat("Cohort genes with >=1 nonsilent, ", VAF_LABEL, " mutation: ", nrow(gene_summary), "\n", sep = "")
for (nm in names(top_gene_sets)) {
  cat(" ", nm, ":", length(top_gene_sets[[nm]]), "genes\n")
}
cat("\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Concordance check against the TopGenes frequency table:
# Mutated tumors per gene here must equal Mutated_Samples there.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

freq_dt <- fread(gene_freq_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)
if (!all(c("Hugo_Symbol", "Mutated_Samples") %in% colnames(freq_dt))) {
  stop("Frequency table must contain Hugo_Symbol and Mutated_Samples columns.")
}
freq_dt[, Gene_key := clean_key(Hugo_Symbol)]

largest_top_n  <- max(TOP_N_VALUES)
genes_to_check <- head(gene_summary$Gene_key, largest_top_n)

concordance <- merge(
  data.table(Gene_key = genes_to_check),
  gene_summary[, .(Gene_key, Mutated_samples_this_script = n_altered_samples)],
  by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE
)
concordance <- merge(
  concordance,
  freq_dt[, .(Gene_key, Mutated_samples_frequency_table = Mutated_Samples)],
  by = "Gene_key", all.x = TRUE
)
concordance[is.na(Mutated_samples_frequency_table), Mutated_samples_frequency_table := 0L]
concordance[, Agree := Mutated_samples_this_script == Mutated_samples_frequency_table]
setorder(concordance, Agree, -Mutated_samples_this_script)

fwrite(concordance,
       file.path(table_dir, paste0("concordance_with_frequency_table_top", largest_top_n, "_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
       sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, na = "")

cat("Top", largest_top_n, "genes checked against the frequency table:", nrow(concordance), "\n")
cat("Genes that disagree:", concordance[Agree == FALSE, .N], "\n\n")
if (concordance[Agree == FALSE, .N] > 0) {
  warning("Counts disagree with the frequency table for some genes; check that the MAF, ",
          "VAF audit and frequency table come from the same TopGenes run.")
  print(concordance[Agree == FALSE])
}

# ============================================================
# HGVS keys for PCGR oncogenicity matching (unchanged)
# ============================================================

if (!"HGVSp" %in% colnames(maf_dt)) maf_dt[, HGVSp := NA_character_]
if (!"HGVSp_Short" %in% colnames(maf_dt)) maf_dt[, HGVSp_Short := NA_character_]
if (!"HGVSc" %in% colnames(maf_dt)) maf_dt[, HGVSc := NA_character_]

maf_dt[, HGVSp_key := clean_hgv(HGVSp)]
maf_dt[, HGVSp_Short_key := clean_hgv(HGVSp_Short)]
maf_dt[, HGVSc_key := clean_hgv(HGVSc)]

cat("Unique mutated samples:", uniqueN(maf_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode), "\n")
cat("Unique mutated genes:", uniqueN(maf_dt$Hugo_Symbol), "\n\n")

cat("Clinical samples matching MAF samples:",
    sum(clean_sample(all_samples) %in% clinical_plot_dt$Sample_key), "\n\n")

# Optional detailed match check
maf_samples_check <- data.table(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = all_samples)
maf_samples_check[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]

clinical_samples_check <- unique(clinical_plot_dt[, .(Sample_key)])
clinical_samples_check[, In_clinical := TRUE]

match_check <- merge(
  maf_samples_check,
  clinical_samples_check,
  by = "Sample_key",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

match_check[is.na(In_clinical), In_clinical := FALSE]

cat("Total MAF samples:", nrow(match_check), "\n")
cat("Matched to clinical:", sum(match_check$In_clinical), "\n")
cat("Not matched:", sum(!match_check$In_clinical), "\n\n")

if (sum(!match_check$In_clinical) > 0) {
  cat("Unmatched MAF samples:\n")
  print(match_check[In_clinical == FALSE])
}
```

```{r read_pcgr}
# ============================================================
# Read PCGR xlsx files and extract ONCOGENICITY (unchanged)
# ============================================================

pcgr_files <- list.files(
  pcgr_dir,
  pattern = "\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(pcgr_files) == 0) {
  pcgr_files <- list.files(
    pcgr_dir,
    pattern = "\\.xlsx$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
}

cat("PCGR xlsx files found:", length(pcgr_files), "\n\n")

pcgr_list <- list()

for (f in pcgr_files) {

  sample_name <- basename(dirname(f))

  sheets <- tryCatch(
    excel_sheets(f),
    error = function(e) character()
  )

  if (!"SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL" %in% sheets) {
    message("[SKIP] SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL sheet not found: ", f)
    next
  }

  dt <- tryCatch(
    as.data.table(read_excel(f, sheet = "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL")),
    error = function(e) {
      message("[SKIP] Could not read: ", f)
      message("       ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (is.null(dt) || nrow(dt) == 0) {
    next
  }

  gene_col <- find_col(
    colnames(dt),
    c("Hugo_Symbol", "HUGO_SYMBOL", "Gene", "Gene_Symbol", "SYMBOL", "GENE_NAME")
  )

  onc_col <- find_col(
    colnames(dt),
    c("ONCOGENICITY", "Oncogenicity")
  )

  if (is.na(gene_col) || is.na(onc_col)) {
    message("[SKIP] Could not find Gene or ONCOGENICITY column in: ", f)
    next
  }

  pcgr_tmp <- data.table(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode_PCGR = sample_name,
    Sample_key = clean_sample(sample_name),
    Hugo_Symbol_PCGR = as.character(dt[[gene_col]]),
    Gene_key = clean_key(dt[[gene_col]]),
    ONCOGENICITY_RAW = as.character(dt[[onc_col]]),
    HGVSp_key = clean_hgv(get_col_or_na(dt, c("HGVSp", "HGVSP", "Protein_Change", "ProteinChange"))),
    HGVSp_Short_key = clean_hgv(get_col_or_na(dt, c("HGVSp_Short", "HGVSP_SHORT"))),
    HGVSc_key = clean_hgv(get_col_or_na(dt, c("HGVSc", "HGVSC", "Coding_Change", "CodingChange"))),
    PCGR_file = f
  )

  pcgr_tmp[, ONCOGENICITY := normalize_oncogenicity(ONCOGENICITY_RAW)]

  # Keep only Oncogenic and Likely_Oncogenic
  pcgr_tmp <- pcgr_tmp[!is.na(ONCOGENICITY)]

  if (nrow(pcgr_tmp) > 0) {
    pcgr_list[[length(pcgr_list) + 1]] <- pcgr_tmp
  }
}

if (length(pcgr_list) == 0) {
  warning("No Oncogenic/Likely_Oncogenic PCGR records found.")
  pcgr_dt <- data.table()
} else {
  pcgr_dt <- rbindlist(pcgr_list, fill = TRUE)
}

if (nrow(pcgr_dt) > 0) {
  pcgr_dt[, onc_priority := fifelse(ONCOGENICITY == "Oncogenic", 2L, 1L)]

  cat("PCGR Oncogenic/Likely_Oncogenic rows:", nrow(pcgr_dt), "\n")
  print(pcgr_dt[, .N, by = ONCOGENICITY][order(-N)])
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r match_pcgr_to_maf}
# ============================================================
# Match PCGR oncogenicity back to MAF variant rows (unchanged)
# ============================================================

maf_annot <- maf_dt[
  ,
  .(
    maf_row_id,
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
    Hugo_Symbol,
    Sample_key,
    Gene_key,
    HGVSp_key,
    HGVSp_Short_key,
    HGVSc_key
  )
]

maf_annot[, ONCOGENICITY := NA_character_]
maf_annot[, oncogenicity_match_method := NA_character_]

add_pcgr_match <- function(maf_annot, pcgr_dt, keys, method_name) {

  if (nrow(pcgr_dt) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  pcgr_sub <- copy(pcgr_dt)

  for (k in keys) {
    pcgr_sub <- pcgr_sub[!is.na(get(k)) & get(k) != ""]
  }

  if (nrow(pcgr_sub) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  pcgr_best <- pcgr_sub[
    order(-onc_priority),
    .(
      ONCOGENICITY_MATCH = first(ONCOGENICITY),
      PCGR_match_priority = first(onc_priority),
      PCGR_n_matching_records = .N
    ),
    by = keys
  ]

  maf_unmatched <- maf_annot[is.na(ONCOGENICITY)]

  for (k in keys) {
    maf_unmatched <- maf_unmatched[!is.na(get(k)) & get(k) != ""]
  }

  if (nrow(maf_unmatched) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  tmp <- merge(
    maf_unmatched[, c("maf_row_id", keys), with = FALSE],
    pcgr_best,
    by = keys,
    all.x = FALSE,
    all.y = FALSE,
    allow.cartesian = TRUE
  )

  if (nrow(tmp) == 0) {
    return(maf_annot)
  }

  tmp <- tmp[
    order(-PCGR_match_priority),
    .SD[1],
    by = maf_row_id
  ]

  maf_annot[
    tmp,
    on = "maf_row_id",
    `:=`(
      ONCOGENICITY = i.ONCOGENICITY_MATCH,
      oncogenicity_match_method = method_name
    )
  ]

  return(maf_annot)
}

if (nrow(pcgr_dt) > 0) {

  maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
    maf_annot,
    pcgr_dt,
    keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key", "HGVSp_key"),
    method_name = "Sample+Gene+HGVSp"
  )

  maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
    maf_annot,
    pcgr_dt,
    keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key", "HGVSp_Short_key"),
    method_name = "Sample+Gene+HGVSp_Short"
  )

  maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
    maf_annot,
    pcgr_dt,
    keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key", "HGVSc_key"),
    method_name = "Sample+Gene+HGVSc"
  )

  if (allow_sample_gene_fallback) {
    maf_annot <- add_pcgr_match(
      maf_annot,
      pcgr_dt,
      keys = c("Sample_key", "Gene_key"),
      method_name = "Sample+Gene_fallback"
    )
  }
}

maf_dt <- merge(
  maf_dt,
  maf_annot[, .(maf_row_id, ONCOGENICITY, oncogenicity_match_method)],
  by = "maf_row_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

cat("MAF rows matched to PCGR Oncogenic/Likely_Oncogenic:\n")
print(
  maf_dt[
    !is.na(ONCOGENICITY),
    .N,
    by = .(ONCOGENICITY, oncogenicity_match_method)
  ][order(ONCOGENICITY, oncogenicity_match_method)]
)
cat("\n")

fwrite(
  maf_dt[
    ,
    .(
      Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
      Hugo_Symbol,
      Variant_Classification,
      VAF_percent,
      HGVSp,
      HGVSp_Short,
      HGVSc,
      ONCOGENICITY,
      oncogenicity_match_method
    )
  ],
  file = file.path(table_dir, paste0("variant_level_pcgr_oncogenicity_match_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

```{r define_plot_function}
# ============================================================
# Main plotting function (unchanged; still receives VAF-filtered maf_dt;
# works for any gene vector, not just functional-category gene lists)
# ============================================================

make_category_oncoplot <- function(category_name, genes) {

  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat("Gene set:", category_name, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  genes <- unique(genes)
  genes_key <- clean_key(genes)

  cat_maf <- maf_dt[Gene_key %in% genes_key]

  if (nrow(cat_maf) == 0) {
    cat("No mutated genes from this gene set found in MAF. Skipping.\n\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Fixed sample order from low TP number to high TP number
  plot_samples <- all_samples

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cell-level summary
  # Multi_Hit = >1 VAF-filtered variant row in same Sample + Gene
  # Oncogenicity priority = Oncogenic > Likely_Oncogenic
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cell_dt <- cat_maf[
    ,
    {
      onc_vals <- ONCOGENICITY[!is.na(ONCOGENICITY)]

      cell_onc <- ""

      if ("Oncogenic" %in% onc_vals) {
        cell_onc <- "Oncogenic"
      } else if ("Likely_Oncogenic" %in% onc_vals) {
        cell_onc <- "Likely_Oncogenic"
      }

      list(
        n_variants = .N,
        Display = ifelse(.N > 1, "Multi_Hit", as.character(Variant_Classification[1])),
        Variant_Classification_List = paste(unique(Variant_Classification), collapse = ";"),
        HGVSp_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSp)), collapse = ";"),
        HGVSc_List = paste(unique(na.omit(HGVSc)), collapse = ";"),
        VAF_percent_List = paste(unique(na.omit(VAF_percent)), collapse = ";"),
        Cell_ONCOGENICITY = cell_onc,
        ONCOGENICITY_List = paste(unique(na.omit(ONCOGENICITY)), collapse = ";"),
        ONCOGENICITY_match_methods = paste(unique(na.omit(oncogenicity_match_method)), collapse = ";")
      )
    },
    by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Hugo_Symbol, Gene_key)
  ]

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Order genes by alteration frequency: high to low
  # Tie-breaker 1 = total variant rows in that gene
  # Tie-breaker 2 = original gene-list order (rank order passed in)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  gene_order_dt <- cell_dt[
    ,
    .(
      n_altered_samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
      n_variant_rows = sum(n_variants),
      category_order = match(Gene_key[1], genes_key)
    ),
    by = .(Gene_key, Hugo_Symbol)
  ]

  setorder(
    gene_order_dt,
    -n_altered_samples,
    -n_variant_rows,
    category_order,
    Hugo_Symbol
  )

  plot_genes <- gene_order_dt$Hugo_Symbol
  names(plot_genes) <- NULL

  category_safe <- safe_file_name(category_name)

  fwrite(
    cell_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_cell_level_oncoplot_table.tsv")),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Build mutation matrix and oncogenicity matrix
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mut_mat <- matrix(
    "",
    nrow = length(plot_genes),
    ncol = length(plot_samples),
    dimnames = list(plot_genes, plot_samples)
  )

  onc_mat <- matrix(
    "",
    nrow = length(plot_genes),
    ncol = length(plot_samples),
    dimnames = list(plot_genes, plot_samples)
  )

  for (ii in seq_len(nrow(cell_dt))) {
    g <- cell_dt$Hugo_Symbol[ii]
    s <- cell_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[ii]

    if (g %in% rownames(mut_mat) && s %in% colnames(mut_mat)) {
      mut_mat[g, s] <- cell_dt$Display[ii]
      onc_mat[g, s] <- cell_dt$Cell_ONCOGENICITY[ii]
    }
  }

  plot_mat <- mut_mat
  plot_mat[plot_mat == ""] <- NA_character_

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Top stacked barplot: number of mutation rows per sample
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  sample_class_dt <- cat_maf[
    ,
    .N,
    by = .(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Variant_Classification)
  ]

  sample_class_mat_dt <- dcast(
    sample_class_dt,
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode ~ Variant_Classification,
    value.var = "N",
    fill = 0
  )

  sample_class_mat_dt <- merge(
    data.table(Tumor_Sample_Barcode = plot_samples),
    sample_class_mat_dt,
    by = "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )

  sample_class_mat_dt <- sample_class_mat_dt[
    match(plot_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  ]

  sample_class_cols <- setdiff(colnames(sample_class_mat_dt), "Tumor_Sample_Barcode")

  if (length(sample_class_cols) == 0) {

    sample_class_mat <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow = length(plot_samples),
      ncol = 1,
      dimnames = list(plot_samples, "No_mutation")
    )

  } else {

    for (cc in sample_class_cols) {
      sample_class_mat_dt[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0]
    }

    sample_class_mat <- as.matrix(sample_class_mat_dt[, ..sample_class_cols])
    rownames(sample_class_mat) <- sample_class_mat_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Bottom clinical annotations
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  plot_sample_keys <- clean_sample(plot_samples)

  sample_clin_dt <- data.table(
    Tumor_Sample_Barcode = plot_samples,
    Sample_key = plot_sample_keys
  )

  sample_clin_dt <- merge(
    sample_clin_dt,
    clinical_plot_dt,
    by = "Sample_key",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )

  sample_clin_dt <- sample_clin_dt[
    match(plot_samples, Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
  ]

  sample_clin_dt[, Column_Index := seq_len(.N)]

  setcolorder(
    sample_clin_dt,
    c(
      "Column_Index",
      "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
      "Sample_key",
      setdiff(
        colnames(sample_clin_dt),
        c("Column_Index", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Sample_key")
      )
    )
  )

  fwrite(
    sample_clin_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv")),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  clinical_anno_df <- data.frame(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = sample_clin_dt$tumor_cellularity_pct,
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = sample_clin_dt$pleomorphic_component_cellularity_pct,
    `TILs (%)` = sample_clin_dt$TILs_pct,
    Grade = sample_clin_dt$Grade_clean,
    HER2 = sample_clin_dt$HER2_status,
    ER = sample_clin_dt$ER_status,
    PR = sample_clin_dt$PR_status,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  rownames(clinical_anno_df) <- plot_samples

  observed_grade_levels <- unique(na.omit(clinical_anno_df$Grade))
  observed_grade_levels <- observed_grade_levels[observed_grade_levels != ""]

  missing_grade_levels <- setdiff(observed_grade_levels, names(grade_cols))

  grade_cols_local <- grade_cols

  if (length(missing_grade_levels) > 0) {
    extra_grade_cols <- hcl.colors(length(missing_grade_levels), palette = "Dark 3")
    names(extra_grade_cols) <- missing_grade_levels
    grade_cols_local <- c(grade_cols_local, extra_grade_cols)
  }

  clinical_anno_cols <- list(
    `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRamp2(
      c(0, 50, 100),
      c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B")
    ),
    `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRamp2(
      c(0, 50, 100),
      c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B")
    ),
    `TILs (%)` = colorRamp2(
      c(0, 30, 100),
      c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A", "#67000D")
    ),
    Grade = grade_cols_local,
    HER2 = binary_receptor_cols,
    ER = binary_receptor_cols,
    PR = binary_receptor_cols
  )

  if (length(setdiff(colnames(clinical_anno_df), names(clinical_anno_cols))) > 0) {
    stop("Clinical annotation dataframe and color list names do not match.")
  }

  bottom_clin_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    ` ` = anno_empty(
      height = unit(1, "mm"),
      border = FALSE
    ),
    df = clinical_anno_df,
    col = clinical_anno_cols,
    na_col = "grey90",
    which = "column",
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_rot = 0,
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    simple_anno_size = unit(0.30, "cm"),
    gap = unit(c(3.5, rep(1.1, ncol(clinical_anno_df) - 1)), "mm"),
    show_annotation_name = c(
      ` ` = FALSE,
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = TRUE,
      `Pleomorphic (%)` = TRUE,
      `TILs (%)` = TRUE,
      Grade = TRUE,
      HER2 = TRUE,
      ER = TRUE,
      PR = TRUE
    ),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      `Tumor cell. (%)` = list(title = "Tumor cell. (%)"),
      `Pleomorphic (%)` = list(title = "Pleomorphic (%)"),
      `TILs (%)` = list(title = "TILs (%)"),
      Grade = list(title = "Grade"),
      HER2 = list(title = "HER2"),
      ER = list(title = "ER"),
      PR = list(title = "PR")
    )
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Right-side stacked barplot: altered samples per gene by class
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  gene_class_dt <- cell_dt[
    ,
    .N,
    by = .(Hugo_Symbol, Display)
  ]

  gene_class_mat_dt <- dcast(
    gene_class_dt,
    Hugo_Symbol ~ Display,
    value.var = "N",
    fill = 0
  )

  gene_class_mat_dt <- merge(
    data.table(Hugo_Symbol = plot_genes),
    gene_class_mat_dt,
    by = "Hugo_Symbol",
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )

  gene_class_mat_dt <- gene_class_mat_dt[
    match(plot_genes, Hugo_Symbol)
  ]

  gene_class_cols <- setdiff(colnames(gene_class_mat_dt), "Hugo_Symbol")

  if (length(gene_class_cols) == 0) {

    gene_class_mat <- matrix(
      0,
      nrow = length(plot_genes),
      ncol = 1,
      dimnames = list(plot_genes, "No_mutation")
    )

  } else {

    for (cc in gene_class_cols) {
      gene_class_mat_dt[is.na(get(cc)), (cc) := 0]
    }

    gene_class_mat <- as.matrix(gene_class_mat_dt[, ..gene_class_cols])
    rownames(gene_class_mat) <- gene_class_mat_dt$Hugo_Symbol
  }

  gene_mutated_sample_counts <- rowSums(mut_mat != "")
  gene_mutated_sample_pct <- round(100 * gene_mutated_sample_counts / ncol(mut_mat))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mutation colors for heatmap and stacked barplots
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  mut_types_heatmap <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.vector(plot_mat))))
  sample_bar_classes <- colnames(sample_class_mat)
  row_bar_classes <- colnames(gene_class_mat)

  all_mutation_types_for_plot <- sort(unique(c(
    mut_types_heatmap,
    sample_bar_classes,
    row_bar_classes
  )))

  all_mutation_types_for_plot <- setdiff(all_mutation_types_for_plot, "No_mutation")

  mutation_colors <- get_mutation_colors(all_mutation_types_for_plot)

  sample_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[sample_bar_classes]
  sample_bar_colors[is.na(sample_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

  row_bar_colors <- mutation_colors[row_bar_classes]
  row_bar_colors[is.na(row_bar_colors)] <- "grey50"

  top_bar_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    `Mutations per sample` = anno_barplot(
      sample_class_mat,
      gp = gpar(fill = sample_bar_colors, col = NA),
      border = FALSE,
      bar_width = 0.97,
      height = unit(2.2, "cm"),
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
    ),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )

  right_bar_ha <- rowAnnotation(
    `Altered samples by class` = anno_barplot(
      gene_class_mat,
      gp = gpar(fill = row_bar_colors, col = NA),
      border = FALSE,
      bar_width = 0.90,
      axis = TRUE,
      axis_param = list(
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
        side = "bottom"
      )
    ),
    `% altered` = anno_text(
      paste0(gene_mutated_sample_pct, "%"),
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
      just = "left",
      location = 0
    ),
    width = unit(4.2, "cm"),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Square cell size
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  cell_size_mm <- 4.0

  heatmap_body_width_mm <- max(55, cell_size_mm * ncol(mut_mat))
  heatmap_body_height_mm <- max(38, cell_size_mm * nrow(mut_mat))

  plot_width <- max(13, min(26, heatmap_body_width_mm / 25.4 + 9.5))
  plot_height <- max(8, min(24, heatmap_body_height_mm / 25.4 + 5.5))

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # PCGR oncogenicity symbol legend
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  onc_lgd <- Legend(
    title = "PCGR oncogenicity",
    type = "points",
    labels = c("Oncogenic", "Likely_Oncogenic"),
    pch = c(8, 24),
    size = unit(c(2.0, 2.0), "mm"),
    legend_gp = gpar(col = "black", fill = "black")
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Heatmap / oncoplot-like plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  ht <- Heatmap(
    plot_mat,
    name = "Mutation type",
    col = mutation_colors,
    na_col = "grey80",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    row_order = plot_genes,
    column_order = plot_samples,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    column_title = paste0(
      category_name,
      " | genes: ", nrow(mut_mat),
      " | samples: ", ncol(mut_mat),
      " | ", VAF_LABEL
    ),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
    width = unit(heatmap_body_width_mm, "mm"),
    height = unit(heatmap_body_height_mm, "mm"),
    rect_gp = gpar(type = "none"),
    top_annotation = top_bar_ha,
    bottom_annotation = bottom_clin_ha,
    right_annotation = right_bar_ha,
    column_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
    row_gap = unit(0.05, "mm"),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "Mutation type",
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
    ),
    layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

      grid.rect(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        width = width * 0.995,
        height = height * 0.995,
        gp = gpar(fill = "grey80", col = "white", lwd = 0.10)
      )

      for (kk in seq_along(x)) {

        this_mut <- mut_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]

        if (!is.na(this_mut) && this_mut != "") {
          grid.rect(
            x = x[kk],
            y = y[kk],
            width = width[kk] * 0.96,
            height = height[kk] * 0.96,
            gp = gpar(fill = mutation_colors[this_mut], col = NA)
          )
        }
      }

      for (kk in seq_along(x)) {

        this_mut <- mut_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]
        this_onc <- onc_mat[i[kk], j[kk]]

        symbol_col <- "black"

        if (!is.na(this_mut) && this_mut == "Multi_Hit") {
          symbol_col <- "white"
        }

        if (!is.na(this_onc) && this_onc == "Oncogenic") {

          grid.points(
            x = x[kk],
            y = y[kk],
            pch = 8,
            size = unit(1.8, "mm"),
            gp = gpar(col = symbol_col, fill = symbol_col, lwd = 1.0)
          )

        } else if (!is.na(this_onc) && this_onc == "Likely_Oncogenic") {

          grid.points(
            x = x[kk],
            y = y[kk],
            pch = 24,
            size = unit(1.8, "mm"),
            gp = gpar(col = symbol_col, fill = symbol_col, lwd = 1.0)
          )
        }
      }
    }
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save PDF and PNG
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pdf_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(category_safe, "_oncoplot_PCGR_oncogenicity_", VAF_TAG, ".pdf")
  )

  png_file <- file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0(category_safe, "_oncoplot_PCGR_oncogenicity_", VAF_TAG, ".png")
  )

  pdf(pdf_file, width = plot_width, height = plot_height)

  draw(
    ht,
    heatmap_legend_side = "right",
    annotation_legend_side = "right",
    heatmap_legend_list = list(onc_lgd),
    merge_legends = FALSE,
    padding = unit(c(4, 28, 6, 4), "mm")
  )

  dev.off()

  if (isTRUE(SAVE_PNG)) {

    png(
      filename = png_file,
      width = plot_width,
      height = plot_height,
      units = "in",
      res = 300
    )

    draw(
      ht,
      heatmap_legend_side = "right",
      annotation_legend_side = "right",
      heatmap_legend_list = list(onc_lgd),
      merge_legends = FALSE,
      padding = unit(c(4, 28, 6, 4), "mm")
    )

    dev.off()

  } else {
    png_file <- NA_character_
  }

  cat("Saved:\n")
  cat("  ", pdf_file, "\n")
  if (!is.na(png_file)) {
    cat("  ", png_file, "\n")
  }
  cat("  ", file.path(table_dir, paste0(category_safe, "_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv")), "\n\n")

  summary_dt <- data.table(
    Gene_set = category_name,
    Genes_requested = length(genes),
    Mutated_genes_plotted = nrow(mut_mat),
    Samples_shown = ncol(mut_mat),
    Cells_with_mutation = sum(mut_mat != ""),
    Cells_with_Oncogenic_symbol = sum(onc_mat == "Oncogenic"),
    Cells_with_Likely_Oncogenic_symbol = sum(onc_mat == "Likely_Oncogenic"),
    Mutation_filter = paste0("nonsilent, PCGR ", VAF_LABEL),
    PDF = pdf_file,
    PNG = png_file,
    Sample_order_TSV = file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(category_safe, "_sample_order_and_clinical_annotation.tsv")
    ),
    Cell_level_TSV = file.path(
      table_dir,
      paste0(category_safe, "_cell_level_oncoplot_table.tsv")
    )
  )

  graphics.off()
  gc()

  return(summary_dt)
}
```

```{r run_all_top_gene_sets}
# ============================================================
# Generate the top-N oncoplots (one per value in TOP_N_VALUES)
# ============================================================

graphics.off()
gc()

gene_set_summaries <- list()

for (gene_set_name in names(top_gene_sets)) {

  cat("\n\n############################################################\n")
  cat("Running gene set:", gene_set_name, "\n")
  cat("############################################################\n\n")

  res <- tryCatch(
    {
      make_category_oncoplot(
        category_name = gene_set_name,
        genes = top_gene_sets[[gene_set_name]]
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("[ERROR] Failed gene set: ", gene_set_name)
      message("Reason: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(res)) {
    gene_set_summaries[[length(gene_set_summaries) + 1]] <- res
  }

  graphics.off()
  gc()
}

if (length(gene_set_summaries) > 0) {

  gene_set_summary_dt <- rbindlist(gene_set_summaries, fill = TRUE)

  fwrite(
    gene_set_summary_dt,
    file = file.path(table_dir, paste0("top_gene_set_oncoplot_summary_", VAF_TAG, ".tsv")),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )

  print(gene_set_summary_dt)
}

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(out_dir, paste0("sessionInfo_top_genes_", VAF_TAG, ".txt"))
)

cat("\nAll done.\n")
cat("Plots saved in:\n", out_dir, "\n")
cat("Tables saved in:\n", table_dir, "\n")
```
